# proxmox_node_oci_pull (Resource)

Pulls an OCI image into a storage through `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/oci-registry-pull` and waits for the worker.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_oci_pull" "img" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  storage   = "local"
  reference = "docker.io/library/alpine:latest"
  triggers  = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `reference` (String) OCI reference such as `docker.io/library/alpine:latest`.
- `storage` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `filename` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
